notes:
- The app no longer closes by itself while playing a video on NVIDIA cards (the video is decoded with Direct3D 11, smooth and safe).
- If the app ever closes by itself, the reason is written to logs\crash_trace.log for the admin.
- 🔍 Lines to check (📝 Transcript): the lines worth a look – no subtitle on the video shows them, or Whisper is not sure – one click each, ✓ OK when right.
- Batch / Auto Dub: Gemini listens to the unsure lines and confirms them; grunts heard as words get no voice. ✅ Quality check lists what is left – double-click opens the episode.
- A subtitle read twice by the OCR is voiced once (no more "1,400 km 1,400 km"), and pieces repeating the line next to them are dropped.
- Voice style is now "Original VoxDub" by default: the video is never slowed (it looked like slow motion); when it is chosen, at most to 0.75 ×.
- New speech engines to try: Paraformer-zh and SenseVoice-Small (fast, with the VoxCPM engine) – Whisper stays the best for dubbing.
- Batch: two episodes reading the subtitles on the GPU at once no longer close the app.
